candidates.summary: We present GHARP (Real-time Gaussian Head Animation from Large-scale Reconstruction Prior), a method that animates 3D human heads in real time from a few input images of a subject and a driving expression signal. candidates.title: Selection-Based Structured Reasoning: Toward Efficient Multimodal Search Agents
candidates.summary: Multimodal agents commonly generate freeform reasoning before each action. candidates.title: Independent Research Challenge: Can AI Memory Survive Across Different Models? — ALAYA-999
candidates.summary:
I am César Agliardi Pereira, an independent researcher from Brazil and creator of ALAYA-999.

I invite the international AI research community to participate in an independent replication challenge.

Research question:

Can different AI models reconstruct the same documented functional identity using a portable, versioned external memory, even when their original conversation history is unavailable?

ALAYA-999 investigates persistent external AI memory, functional identity, cross-model recovery, source verification, and reproducibility.
